text:
maria: quick review — wording for the confirmation dialog when a user aborts a large model/artifact upload. PM wants it clear about partial data + that upload can be restarted. also flagged for keyboard/focus order.

kevin: ack. We should keep the primary button to the right (destructive) per our pattern? iirc we use primary on left elsewhere though. consistency question.

maria: good point. current guideline: primary action first in DOM for keyboard, but destructive actions can be styled secondary. product wants the abort action obvious.

jon: can we present 3 short variants? one friendly, one technical, one urgent. include aria-label suggestions and a short note about focus order.

maria: variants below — react with :one: :two: :three: or comment.

maria: Variant 1 — Friendly
"Abort upload? The upload will stop and any partially uploaded chunks will be discarded. You can restart the upload from the same file later.
[Cancel] [Abort upload]"
aria-labels: primary (Cancel): "Cancel, return to upload"; destructive (Abort upload): "Abort upload and discard partial data"
notes: primary (Cancel) first tabbable element, destructive styled in red but comes second in DOM.

maria: Variant 2 — Technical
"Stop the upload process. Any partial artifacts on the server will be removed. To resume, re-initiate the upload.
[Keep uploading] [Stop upload]"
aria-labels: "Keep uploading" -> "Keep current upload in progress"; "Stop upload" -> "Stop upload and delete partial data"
notes: make sure we announce deletion via aria-live when complete.

maria: Variant 3 — Urgent/Warning
"This will cancel the upload and delete partially uploaded data. Continue only if you want to discard progress.
[No, continue upload] [Yes, abort upload]"
aria-labels: primary: "Continue upload"; destructive: "Confirm: abort upload and delete partial data"
notes: add a short in-dialog hint: "Estimated progress: 48%" if we have it.

tara: accessibility nit: avoid ambiguous labels like "Stop" or "Abort" alone. include "upload" in the CTA. also ensure dialog traps focus and returns focus to the original button. add role=dialog + aria-modal=true.

kevin: product prefers Variant 1 tone, but change primary CTA to "Keep uploading" (so no accidental aborts). also request the destructive CTA to read exactly "Abort upload" (no extra punctuation).

jon: small UX note: put the destructive button last in DOM so keyboard sequence is "Keep uploading" then "Abort upload"; visually we can still emphasize abort with color. Also add a tooltip on the destructive CTA when progress > 0: "Partial data will be removed". tooltip must be reachable via keyboard (focus) and read by screenreaders (role=tooltip).

maria: approved final copy (combines feedback):
Headline: "Cancel upload?"
Body: "The upload will stop and any partially uploaded data will be removed. You can restart the upload later."
Primary (left, first in DOM): "Keep uploading" (aria-label: "Keep current upload")
Destructive (right, second in DOM): "Abort upload" (aria-label: "Abort upload and delete partial data")
Inline hint (small): "Progress: 48%" (optional)
Tooltip on destructive: "Partial data will be removed" (role=tooltip, appears on focus)
A11y checklist: focus trapped in dialog, return focus to original trigger, dialog has role=dialog + aria-modal=true, aria-live polite region for status, tooltip accessible on keyboard.

design-bot: UX copy review tag set: `design/reviewed`

tara: i'll update the Figma component and add the accessibility annotations. ping me if you want the string keys.

maria: thanks — i'll add string keys: `upload.abort.title`, `upload.abort.body`, `upload.cta.keep`, `upload.cta.abort`, `upload.hint.progress` and update the PR.

kevin: thanks all. quick follow-up: also add a mobile layout note (stack buttons vertically, destructive last).

jon: noted. closing this thread after figma update.
